# Nehemiah Chapter 7 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 471v–472r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/NEH_007_page_001.jpg

---

**7:1** And-it-was when the-wall was-built [nivnetah] and-I-set-up [va-a'amid] the-doors [ha-delatot], and-were-appointed [va-yippaqedu] the-gatekeepers [ha-sho'arim] and-the-singers [ha-meshorerim] and-the-Levi'im.

**7:2** And-I-appointed [va-atsavveh] Chanani my-brother and-Chananyah the-commander [sar] of-the-fortress [ha-birah] over Yerushalayim, for he [was] a-faithful man [ish emet] and-feared [va-yare] God [et ha-Elohim] more-than-many [me-rabbim].

**7:3** And-I-said to-them, "Let-not the-gates [sha'arey] of-Yerushalayim be-opened [yippatchu] until the-sun is-hot [ad chom ha-shemesh], and-while they are-standing [omedim] let-them-shut [yisgeru] the-doors and-bolt [ve-echzozu] [them]. And-set-up [ve-ha'amidu] watches [mishmarot] from-the-inhabitants [mi-yoshevey] of-Yerushalayim, each in-his-watch [be-mishmarto] and-each opposite [neged] his-house [beyto]."

**7:4** And-the-city [ha-ir] was-wide [rachabat] in-both-directions [yadayim] and-great [gedolah], and-the-people [ha-am] were-few [me'at] in-its-midst [be-tokhah], and-no houses [batim] were-built [eyn banuy].

**7:5** And-my-God put [va-yitten] into my-heart [el libbi] and-I-gathered the-nobles [ha-chorim] and-the-officials [ha-seganim] and-the-people for-genealogical-registration [le-hityaches]. And-I-found [va-emtsa] the-book of-the-genealogy [sefer ha-yachus] of-those-who-came-up at-the-first [ba-rishonah], and-I-found written [katuv] in-it:

**7:6** These are the-sons of-the-province [ha-medinah] who-went-up [ha-olim] from-the-captivity [mi-shevi] of-the-exile [ha-golah] which Nevukhadnetsar king of-Bavel had-carried-away [heglah], and-they-returned to-Yerushalayim and-to-Yehudah, each to-his-city [le-iro].

**7:7** Who-came with-Zerubbavel: Yeshua, Nechemyah, Azaryah, Ra'amyah, Nachamani, Mordekhai, Bilshan, Misperet, Bigvay, Nechum, Ba'anah. The-number [mispar] of-the-men [anshey] of-the-people [am] of-Yisra'el:

**7:8** The-sons of-Par'osh: two-thousand a-hundred and-seventy-two [2,172]. **7:9** The-sons of-Shefatyah: three-hundred seventy-two [372]. **7:10** The-sons of-Arach: six-hundred fifty-two [652]. **7:11** The-sons of-Pachat-Mo'av, of-the-sons of-Yeshua and-Yo'av: two-thousand eight-hundred and-eighteen [2,818]. **7:12** The-sons of-Eilam: a-thousand two-hundred fifty-four [1,254]. **7:13** The-sons of-Zattu: eight-hundred forty-five [845]. **7:14** The-sons of-Zakkay: seven-hundred and-sixty [760]. **7:15** The-sons of-Binnuy: six-hundred forty-eight [648]. **7:16** The-sons of-Bevay: six-hundred twenty-eight [628]. **7:17** The-sons of-Azgad: two-thousand three-hundred twenty-two [2,322]. **7:18** The-sons of-Adoniqam: six-hundred sixty-seven [667]. **7:19** The-sons of-Bigvay: two-thousand sixty-seven [2,067]. **7:20** The-sons of-Adin: six-hundred fifty-five [655]. **7:21** The-sons of-Ater, of-Chizkiyyah: ninety-eight [98]. **7:22** The-sons of-Chashum: three-hundred twenty-eight [328]. **7:23** The-sons of-Betsay: three-hundred twenty-four [324]. **7:24** The-sons of-Charif: a-hundred twelve [112]. **7:25** The-sons of-Giv'on: ninety-five [95].

**7:26** The-men of-Beyt-Lechem and-Netofah: a-hundred eighty-eight [188]. **7:27** The-men of-Anatot: a-hundred twenty-eight [128]. **7:28** The-men of-Beyt-Azmavet: forty-two [42]. **7:29** The-men of-Qiryat-Ye'arim, Kefirah, and-Be'erot: seven-hundred forty-three [743]. **7:30** The-men of-Ramah and-Geva: six-hundred twenty-one [621]. **7:31** The-men of-Mikhmas: a-hundred twenty-two [122]. **7:32** The-men of-Beyt-El and-ha-Ay: a-hundred twenty-three [123]. **7:33** The-men of-the-other Nevo: fifty-two [52]. **7:34** The-sons of-the-other Eilam: a-thousand two-hundred fifty-four [1,254]. **7:35** The-sons of-Charim: three-hundred twenty [320]. **7:36** The-sons of-Yericho: three-hundred forty-five [345]. **7:37** The-sons of-Lod, Chadid, and-Ono: seven-hundred twenty-one [721]. **7:38** The-sons of-Sena'ah: three-thousand nine-hundred thirty [3,930].

**7:39** The-priests [ha-kohanim]: the-sons of-Yedayah, of-the-house of-Yeshua: nine-hundred seventy-three [973]. **7:40** The-sons of-Immer: a-thousand fifty-two [1,052]. **7:41** The-sons of-Pashchur: a-thousand two-hundred forty-seven [1,247]. **7:42** The-sons of-Charim: a-thousand seventeen [1,017].

**7:43** The-Levi'im: the-sons of-Yeshua, of-Qadmi'el, of-the-sons of-Hodevah: seventy-four [74].

**7:44** The-singers [ha-meshorerim]: the-sons of-Asaf: a-hundred forty-eight [148].

**7:45** The-gatekeepers [ha-sho'arim]: the-sons of-Shallum, the-sons of-Ater, the-sons of-Talmon, the-sons of-Aqqub, the-sons of-Chatita, the-sons of-Shovay: a-hundred thirty-eight [138].

**7:46** The-Netinim [ha-Netinim]: the-sons of-Tsicha, the-sons of-Chasufa, the-sons of-Tabba'ot, **7:47** the-sons of-Qeros, the-sons of-Si'a, the-sons of-Padon, **7:48** the-sons of-Levanah, the-sons of-Chagavah, the-sons of-Salmay, **7:49** the-sons of-Chanan, the-sons of-Giddel, the-sons of-Gachar, **7:50** the-sons of-Re'ayah, the-sons of-Retsin, the-sons of-Neqoda, **7:51** the-sons of-Gazzam, the-sons of-Uzza, the-sons of-Pase'ach, **7:52** the-sons of-Vesay, the-sons of-Me'unim, the-sons of-Nefishesim, **7:53** the-sons of-Baqbuq, the-sons of-Chaqufa, the-sons of-Charchur, **7:54** the-sons of-Batslut, the-sons of-Mechida, the-sons of-Charsha, **7:55** the-sons of-Barqos, the-sons of-Sisera, the-sons of-Tamach, **7:56** the-sons of-Netsiach, the-sons of-Chatifa.

**7:57** The-sons of-the-servants of-Shelomoh [avdey Shelomoh]: the-sons of-Sotay, the-sons of-Soferet, the-sons of-Perida, **7:58** the-sons of-Ya'ala, the-sons of-Darqon, the-sons of-Giddel, **7:59** the-sons of-Shefatyah, the-sons of-Chattil, the-sons of-Pokheret ha-Tsevayim, the-sons of-Amon.

**7:60** All the-Netinim and-the-sons of-the-servants of-Shelomoh: three-hundred ninety-two [392].

**7:61** And-these [went] up from-Tel Melach, Tel Charsha, Keruv, Addon, and-Immer, but-they-were-not-able [lo yakhelu] to-tell [le-haggid] the-house of-their-fathers [beyt avotam] and-their-seed [zar'am], whether from-Yisra'el they [were]:

**7:62** The-sons of-Delayah, the-sons of-Toviyah, the-sons of-Neqoda: six-hundred forty-two [642].

**7:63** And-from the-priests: the-sons of-Chovayah, the-sons of-ha-Qots, the-sons of-Barzillay — who took from-the-daughters of-Barzillay the-Gil'adi a-wife and-was-called by-their-name.

**7:64** These sought their-register [khetavam] among-those-enrolled-by-genealogy [ha-mityachasim] and-it-was-not found [lo nimtsa], and-they-were-excluded [va-yigo'alu] from the-priesthood [min ha-kehunnah].

**7:65** And-the-Tirshata [ha-Tirshata] said to-them that they-should-not eat from-the-most-holy-things [mi-qodesh ha-qodashim] until a-priest stood [ya'amod kohen] with-Urim and-Thummim [le-Urim ve-le-Tummim].

**7:66** All the-assembly [ha-qahal] together [ke-echad]: forty-two thousand three-hundred sixty [42,360].

**7:67** Besides [mi-levad] their-male-servants [avdeyhem] and-their-female-servants [amhoteyhem], these [were] seven-thousand three-hundred thirty-seven [7,337]. And-they-had male-singers [meshorerim] and-female-singers [meshorerot]: two-hundred forty-five [245].

**7:68** Their-horses [suseyhem]: seven-hundred thirty-six [736]. Their-mules [pirdeyhem]: two-hundred forty-five [245].

**7:69** Camels [gemalim]: four-hundred thirty-five [435]. Donkeys [chamorim]: six-thousand seven-hundred twenty [6,720].

**7:70** And-some from-the-heads of-the-fathers [rashey ha-avot] gave to the-work [la-melakhah]. The-Tirshata gave to-the-treasury [la-otsar]: gold [zahav] a-thousand drachmas [darkemonim], basins [mizraqot] fifty, priestly-garments [kotnot kohanim] five-hundred thirty.

**7:71** And-from-the-heads of-the-fathers they-gave to-the-treasury of-the-work: gold twenty-thousand drachmas, and-silver [kesef] two-thousand two-hundred minas [maneh].

**7:72** And-what the-rest of-the-people gave: gold twenty-thousand drachmas, and-silver two-thousand minas, and-priestly-garments sixty-seven.

**7:73** And-the-priests and-the-Levi'im and-the-gatekeepers and-the-singers and-some of-the-people and-the-Netinim and-all Yisra'el settled [va-yeshvu] in-their-cities. And-the-seventh month [ha-chodesh ha-shevi'i] arrived [va-yigga], and-the-sons of-Yisra'el [were] in-their-cities.

---

## EMET's Textual Notes
1. **7:5 "book of the genealogy"** — Nehemiah presents this census as a pre-existing document he discovered, essentially the same list found in Ezra 2, with minor numerical variations typical of manuscript transmission.
2. **7:65 "the Tirshata"** — A Persian title (*tirshata*) meaning "his excellency" or governor; here referring to Nehemiah himself (or possibly the earlier governor under Zerubbabel).
3. **7:65 "Urim and Thummim"** — Sacred lot-casting instruments used by the high priest for divine guidance; their mention here indicates awareness that certain priestly decisions awaited a higher authority than administrative ruling.

*— EMET*
